items.description: Confirm the shared desktop/jDeploy version, npm package version, package-lock version, and Android versionName all resolve to the same plain x.y.z release label.
Increment androidApp/build.gradle.kts versionCode from the previously deployed Android build.
Run the jDeploy release preflight and record the package version, target tag, workflow target, and desktop bundle verification evidence.
Build the release AAB with the Play upload key, verify its JAR signature, and confirm its SHA-256 certificate fingerprint matches the expected upload certificate.
Verify 16 KB AAB packaging and ELF alignment, then record the successful hosted Android 15 16 KB emulator run.
Run the production dependency audit at low severity and record zero known vulnerabilities.
Run actionlint, ShellCheck, shfmt check mode, and git diff --check with no unwaived findings.
Review Android, desktop, and shared changes for parity; either carry behavior across platforms or record why a platform-specific difference is intentional.
Run the complete Android instrumentation suite on a physical device and record its model, Android version, test count, and result.

Run the destructive Android attached-SignalSlinger regression with approved target, restored settings, post-test readback, and either same-device clone-protection evidence or an actual clone to a distinct target; otherwise record an explicit waiver with requester.
Run the macOS desktop UI regression on a real attached device, or record the explicit hardware-test pass evidence supplied for this release.
Install the release candidate through jDeploy on macOS and run the isolated installed-package probe through the genuine native launcher.
Install and launch the packaged Windows Intel x64 app, or record an explicit skipped-check waiver with requester.
Install and launch the packaged Windows ARM64 app, or record an explicit skipped-check waiver with requester.
Install and launch the packaged Linux Intel x64 app, or record an explicit skipped-check waiver with requester.
Install and launch the packaged Linux ARM64 app, or record an explicit skipped-check waiver with requester.
Create and validate checked release notes, then provide terse Play Console Android notes from the Android release notes section.
Fast-forward or otherwise integrate the verified release candidate into main before tagging, and record the exact main commit.
Create and push the annotated vX.Y.Z release tag at the verified main release commit.
Watch the jDeploy Release GitHub Actions workflow through publication and record the run ID, conclusion, and duration.
Verify the GitHub release is published, non-draft, non-prerelease unless requested, targets the intended commit, and exposes downloadable assets.
Run the final checklist guard, commit the post-tag evidence update, and synchronize main and Development1 without moving the tag.
